verdict.rationale: Dagster exposes a mechanism to wipe/delete dynamic partitions (including multi-partitioned assets), which gives some control over deleting materialized asset data, but there is no evidence of broader retention policies, TTLs, audit trails, or AI-specific data-deletion controls expected for a privacy-posture story. missing for 10: retention policy configuration, deletion audit/compliance features, AI-specific data lifecycle controls, independent corroboration.
